remediation.markdownText: To reduce high Snort CPU usage on Cisco FTD firewalls, optimize Snort settings by disabling unnecessary signatures, adjusting inspection depth, and configuring performance tuning options. Optimizing network traffic and enabling hardware offloading can also improve efficiency. Regularly monitor and analyze Snort performance to identify and address specific issues causing high CPU usage.
